_comment: Claude Desktop MCP config. 'tydal-org' is the org-wide, write-capable management server — see tydal/org-mcp/README.md. 'tydal-vault' is a vault-scoped, read-only-by-default server for one vault — see tydal/vault-mcp/README.md. Build both first: tools/deploy/install_mcp.sh. Copy to: ~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json (macOS) or %APPDATA%\Claude\claude_desktop_config.json (Windows).

env.TYDAL_VAULT_WRITE_KEY: tvk_… (optional — enables ingest on ai vaults)
